title: PersonaCohortRef
description: INSTITUTIONAL_MODEL — opaque reference to a MatrAIx (or compatible) persona cohort used to condition institutional MAS agents. Not a citizen identity, electoral mandate, or probability sample of a real population. Standalone stub: not yet $ref'd from cross-layer-event.json (additionalProperties:false). See docs/integrations/MATRAIX_PERSONA.md.

persona_cohort_id.description: Opaque cohort identifier minted by the sampling adapter

source.description: Corpus provenance; prefer open Persona 1M for research runs

sample_size.description: Number of persona records in the realized cohort (not 8.3B)

filter_recipe_hash.description: Hash of declared strata / filter recipe for reproducibility

persona_agent_model.description: LLM (or agent stack) that plays the personas; first-order factor per MatrAIx

jurisdiction_hint.description: Optional ISO2 / bloc tags used in sampling — modeling hints only

epistemic_label.description: Cohort refs are never COMPUTATIONAL_EVIDENCE by themselves
